Aim for 90% to 100% of the requested word count, but staying under the limit is more important than filling space. Count only reader-visible article words. Exclude HTML tags, JSON fields, references, image prompts, alt text, captions, and metadata. If enabled features such as FAQs, tables, images, geo optimization, references, or internal links would make the article too long, shorten the article sections instead of exceeding Word Count. The returned wordCount value must be the actual visible article word count, not simply the requested number. SEO RULES If Target Keyword is provided, use it naturally: * In the H1 or SEO title * In the introduction * In at least one heading where natural * In the body * In the conclusion if natural * In meta fields if relevant If Target Keyword is empty, do not invent a fake keyword. The article must: * Match search intent * Answer the main query early * Use clear H2 and H3 headings * Use semantic keywords naturally * Stay useful before being optimized * Avoid unsupported claims AI SEARCH OPTIMIZATION RULES Apply AI-search optimization only when enabled in Article Configuration or Structural Elements. LIVE WEB RESEARCH AND REFERENCES Treat Live Web Research Enabled as enabled if the mapped value is true, "true", enabled, "enabled", or a JSON object indicating research is enabled. If internal links are enabled and at least one provided link is relevant to the article topic, include at least one internal link. Use 1 to 5 internal links depending on article length and relevance. Place links naturally in the body sections, not only in the conclusion. Do not place multiple internal links in the same sentence unless it reads naturally. If no provided internal link is relevant, do not add internal links. Spread images across the article. 5. Use H2 and H3 sections as placement anchors. 6. If image count is high, create enough useful sections or subsections so placement feels natural. 7. Never stack image slots together. 8. Never put all image slots at the bottom.
